title: Web billing UI
goal: Owners and billing admins can see their plan, usage and limits, upgrade, change seats with a prorated preview, open the billing portal, and view invoices, in calm, exact, mascot-free screens.
scope_in: Routes in apps/web/src/billing/: `/billing` (overview), `/billing/plans`, `/billing/seats`, `/billing/invoices` using GET /v1/plans, GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/subscription, POST .../checkout, POST .../portal, PATCH .../seats?preview=true, GET .../invoices, GET .../usage/summary, GET .../entitlements, POST .../coupons/redeem.

Plan badges FREE/PRO/TEAM (DESIGN.md 17), usage meters per metered limit with pixel pips for seats (`■■■□□`), persistent meter in settings, 80 % warning banner and 100 % firm banner from `warnings[]` and `usage` vs `limits` (CT-ENTITLEMENTS).
Checkout: POST checkout with required Idempotency-Key, redirect to returned `url`; return page re-fetches entitlements until `rev` changes (poll max 30 s).
Seat changes with proration preview (`?preview=true`) shown before confirm; total with currency, period and tax status always visible before a spend button.
Status handling: `active`, `trialing`, `past_due` (grace until `grace_until`), `canceled` (until period end), `none`; banners and copy per CT-ENTITLEMENTS §4.
Entitlement cache: 5 min TTL, refetch when token `ent` claim changes or on `plan_changed` notice.
scope_out: Entitlement client library and gating helpers (C064); this lane consumes them.
build_against: Mock backend (lane C007) with entitlement fixtures contracts/fixtures/entitlements/*.json (free, pro, team, past_due, canceled, quota 80/100 %) and checkout/portal URLs pointing at a local stub page.
interfaces: export function useEntitlements(wsp: WorkspaceId): {data?: Entitlements; refetch(): Promise<void>; isLoading: boolean}
export function UsageMeter(props: {limitKey: keyof Limits; used: number; limit: number|null; unit: string}): JSX.Element  // limit null renders 'Unlimited'
export function formatMoney(m: {amount: number; currency: 'USD'|'EUR'}, locale: string): string  // integer minor units only
acceptance: Money is rendered from integer minor units via Intl.NumberFormat with the ISO currency; a test with amounts 1900 USD and 1900 EUR shows `$19.00` / `19,00 €` (locale-dependent) and no float arithmetic anywhere (lint ban on `* 0.01`).
A limit of `null` renders 'Unlimited', `0` renders 'None'; unknown limit keys are displayed read-only and never used to unlock anything.
At `warnings[].pct = 80` a warning banner with `!` glyph appears; at usage >= limit a firm banner appears; both are persistent and not dismissible until resolved; max 2 banners stacked.

Seat change flow: preview call shows proration amount; confirm sends PATCH without `preview` and an Idempotency-Key; cancel path takes the same number of clicks as subscribe (<= 3 each, asserted in a Playwright-less click-count test).
Checkout button disabled with tooltip reason for roles other than owner/billing; calling anyway returns 403 `forbidden` handled as toast.

After return from checkout, UI polls entitlements every 2 s up to 30 s until `rev` increases, then shows 'Plan updated'; mascot is not present on any billing route (only static `upgrade_pro` art may show after confirmed success, if at all).
`past_due` shows grace countdown from `grace_until` and an action 'Update payment method' opening the portal; after grace shows free behaviour.
Lighthouse a11y >= 95; all numbers use tabular figures and are right-aligned in tables.
guardrails: MUST NOT use dark patterns: no upgrade modal over active work, prompts only on limit hit or when billing is opened (DESIGN.md 17.1).
MUST show total, currency, period and tax status before any button that spends money.
MUST NOT read plan names or Stripe state to gate features; gate only on entitlement keys (CT-ENTITLEMENTS).
MUST NOT put card data or payment fields in our DOM; checkout and portal are hosted URLs only; the CSP must not be loosened for them (navigate, do not embed).
No mascot and no jokes on payment surfaces; `payment_failed` is plain card icon, calm text, one action.
Checkout and seat POSTs MUST carry Idempotency-Key.
failure_modes: Checkout 409 `idempotency_conflict` -> regenerate key only after user re-initiates; show 'Try again'.
Entitlements fetch fails -> show last known (<= 24 h) marked 'as of <time>' for display only; actions still try the server.
429 `quota_exceeded` on creates elsewhere -> deep link here with the reset date from `retry_after_s`.
